decision.rationale: TXN-008032 (1354.21 EUR, RIVERSIDE GADGETS, MER-000068, on card CRD-000168) posted on 2026-05-26. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 150 days later. The policy allows 120 days from posting, and the time limit is applied first, so the dispute is declined. The time limit applies even when there are fraud indicators. AUTH-008229 does have them: it was an e-commerce payment with 3-D Secure not performed, no CVV and the fraud flag set. Without the time limit, these facts would have counted as card-not-present fraud. The card shows no earlier transactions at this merchant. The cardholder's statement contained no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 150 days after the transaction posted on 2026-05-26. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, so this one cannot be accepted.
